title: pteris daguensis
intro: Pteris daguensis, commonly known as the Chinese fern or Dagu fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta. Pteris daguensis has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pteris daguensis include its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its potential as an anti-inflammatory agent and an antioxidant.
